name: ochre-odoo
displayName: Connector for Odoo by Ochre Digital
description: Hosted connector between your agent and Odoo. Query live sales, pipeline, receivables and stock, inspect models and fields, and build or upgrade custom modules for Odoo 19 with a breaking-change linter. Read only by default, no delete. Built by Ochre Digital, an Odoo implementation partner.

author.name: Ochre Digital (Ochre Tech and Marketing Pvt Ltd)

ODOO_URL.title: Odoo URL
ODOO_URL.description: Base URL of your Odoo instance, e.g. https://yourcompany.odoo.com

ODOO_API_KEY.title: API key
ODOO_API_KEY.description: Create one in Odoo under Preferences > Account Security > New API Key

ODOO_ALLOW_WRITE.title: Allow writes
ODOO_ALLOW_WRITE.description: Set to true to enable create and update tools. Leave false for read-only.
